title: Etale localization tensor on K-flat representatives
statement: For every full subcategory of etale cochain complexes whose objects are K-flat, the total tensor followed by localization is naturally isomorphic to the chosen closed derived tensor of the localizations. Its inverse on every pair is the specified etale localization tensorator.

source.place: Stacks Project, Cohomology on Sites, Tag 07A4; site-transport paragraph.

proof.text: The lax tensorator of localization is invertible when the right input is K-flat, by the K-flat computation of derived tensor and the strong monoidal homotopy quotient.
Restrict its naturality to pairs of objects in the given full subcategory and invert this componentwise isomorphism.

The etale closed and representative normalizations identify its tensor functor and inverse components with the specified chosen data. Keep the specified model-map carrier shared through specialization and express the inverse-component certificate as heterogeneous equality. At the abstract combination step its endpoints coincide, so eq_of_heq recovers precisely the original component equation.

proof_origin.note: Construct the native K-flat localization isomorphism, identify the chosen data, and transport it with all functor data kept abstract.
